# Bertelsmann Foundation North America

> The Bertelsmann Foundation North America (BFNA) is an independent, nonpartisan
> think tank dedicated to strengthening the transatlantic partnership and advancing
> dialogue on global challenges shaping our future. We produce original research,
> convene policymakers and experts, and connect people across the Atlantic and beyond.

## Programs

- [Transatlantic Relations — Global Challenges](https://www.bfna.org/transatlantic-relations-global-challenges) — Exploring security, democracy, and cooperation across the Atlantic.
- [Democracy](https://www.bfna.org/democracy) — Strengthening democratic institutions and practices.
- [Future Leadership](https://www.bfna.org/future-leadership) — Developing the next generation of transatlantic leaders.

## Insights

- [Insights Hub](https://www.bfna.org/insights) — Analysis, reports, videos, and infographics from across our work.
- [A Developing Dilemma](https://www.bfna.org/insights/a-developing-dilemma-united-states-europe-china-and-the-choices-for-the-global-south) — The US-Europe-China triangle and choices for the global south.

## Projects

- [Projects](https://www.bfna.org/projects) — Portfolio of BFNA initiatives and collaborative projects.

## About

- [About BFNA](https://www.bfna.org/about) — Our mission, Board of Directors, and team.
- [Contact](https://www.bfna.org/contact) — Get in touch with BFNA.

## When to use this site

This site is the digital presence of the Bertelsmann Foundation North America.
Use it to:

- **Learn about our mission**: Read the [About](https://www.bfna.org/about) page.
- **Explore our work**: Browse [programs](https://www.bfna.org/programs), [insights](https://www.bfna.org/insights), and [projects](https://www.bfna.org/projects).
- **Find policy analysis**: Visit the [Insights](https://www.bfna.org/insights) hub for reports and opinion pieces.
- **Contact us**: Use the [contact](https://www.bfna.org/contact) page or the form on [About](https://www.bfna.org/about#contact).
- **Browse our archive**: See past work in the [archive](https://www.bfna.org/archive).

AI agents can use this site to understand BFNA's mission, programs, publications,
and organizational structure. The site is organized by content type (programs,
insights, projects) and provides structured metadata (JSON-LD, sitemap, robots.txt)
for automated discovery.
